questions.question: If 4x + 16 = 56, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Subtract 16 from both sides: 4x = 40. Divide by 4: x = 10.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = 2x2 − 12. What is the value of f(−5)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

f(−5) = 2(−5)2 − 12 = 2(25) − 12 = 38.

questions.question: A climbing gym charges a one-time membership fee of $35 plus $13 for each visit. A member has paid $100 in total for the membership fee and visits. How many visits has the member paid for?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Set up 35 + 13n = 100. Then 13n = 65, so n = 5.

questions.question: A rectangular storage box has a length of 8 inches, a width of 3 inches, and a height of 2 inches. What is the volume of the box, in cubic inches?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

Volume = length × width × height = 8 × 3 × 2 = 48.

questions.question: A line in the xy-plane passes through the points (4, −6) and (8, −12). What is the slope of the line?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Slope = (change in y) ÷ (change in x) = (−12 − (−6)) ÷ (8 − 4) = −32.

questions.question: For x > 0, the expression x6 · x7x10 is equivalent to xk. What is the value of k?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 3

Add exponents when multiplying and subtract when dividing: 6 + 7 − 10 = 3.

questions.skill: One-variable data: distributions and measures of center and spread
questions.question: The list shows the numbers of pages students read in one evening: 4, 21, 8, 19, 26, 27, 21. What is the mean of the list?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 18

Sum = 126; there are 7 values; mean = 126 ÷ 7 = 18.

questions.question: The number of visitors to a museum this year is 156, which is 30% greater than it was last year. What was the number last year?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

This year's value is 130% of last year's: 156 ÷ 1310 = 120.

questions.question: The equation P = 6h + 8 gives the pay, in dollars, a tutor earns for h hours of tutoring. What is the best interpretation of 6 in this context?
options: The amount the tutor earns for each hour of tutoring, in dollars
A fixed fee the tutor charges per session, in dollars
The total amount earned for 1 hour, in dollars
The number of hours worked for each dollar earned
questions.correct: The amount the tutor earns for each hour of tutoring, in dollars
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

6 multiplies h, so it is the rate: dollars per hour.

questions.question:
The graph of the linear function f is shown.

Which equation defines f?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

The line crosses the y-axis at (0, 1), so the y-intercept is 1. From (0, 1) to (3, 0) the slope is −1 ÷ 3 = −13.

questions.question: A theater sold adult tickets for $16 each and student tickets for $3 each. The equation 16a + 3b = 82 represents a day on which $82 was collected from a adult tickets and b student tickets. If 6 student tickets were sold that day, how many adult tickets were sold?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Substitute b = 6: 16a + 18 = 82, so 16a = 64 and a = 4.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: What value of x satisfies the equation √x + 10 = 5?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

Square both sides: x + 10 = 25, so x = 15. Check: √25 = 5.

questions.question: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of length 25 and one leg of length 7. What is the length of the other leg?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 24

72 + b2 = 252, so b2 = 576 and b = 24.

questions.question: An investment is modeled by the function f(t) = 2,700(1.2)t, where f(t) is the number of dollars t years after the start. What is the value of f(2)?

The scatterplot shows data for 14 observations and a line of best fit.

The line of best fit has the equation y = 3x + 10. Based on the line of best fit, what is the predicted value of y when x = 8?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Substitute x = 8: y = 3(8) + 10 = 34.

questions.question:
For the polynomial function p, the table shows some values of x and their corresponding values of p(x).

Which of the following must be a factor of p(x)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Because p(4) = 0, 4 is a zero of p, so by the factor theorem x − 4 is a factor of p(x).

questions.question: For x ≠ 3, the expression x2 − 9x − 3 is equivalent to g(x). What is the value of g(11)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

x2 − 9 = (x + 3)(x − 3), so g(x) = x + 3 and g(11) = 14.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: What is the sum of the solutions to 2x2 − 11x + 7 = 0?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

For ax2 + bx + c = 0, the sum of the solutions is −b/a = 112.

questions.question: In the equation 4x + k = 6x + 3, k is a constant. If x = 6 is the solution to the equation, what is the value of k?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Substitute x = 6: 24 + k = 39, so k = 15.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = x2 − 4x + 18. What is the minimum value of f(x)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 14

Complete the square: f(x) = (x − 2)2 + 14. The minimum value occurs at x = 2 and equals 14.

questions.question: In the equation 5x + b = 5(x + 3) + 11, b is a constant. If the equation has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of b?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 26

Expand the right side: 5x + 15 + 11 = 5x + 26. The equation is true for every x only when b = 26.

questions.question: The equation x2 + 4x + y2 − 10y + 13 = 0 defines a circle in the xy-plane. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Complete the square: (x + 2)2 + (y − 5)2 = 4 + 25 − 13 = 16. The radius is 4.

questions.question:
The graph of y = f(x) is shown.

Which equation could define f?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

The vertex is (2, −2) and the parabola opens downward, so f(x) = −(x − 2)2 − 2.

questions.question: Line k is defined by y = −x − 1. Line j is parallel to line k and passes through the point (2, 10). What is the y-intercept of line j?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

Parallel lines have equal slopes, so line j is y = −x + b. Substituting (2, 10): 10 = −1(2) + b, so b = 12.

questions.question: The functions f and g are defined by f(x) = −3x + 5 and g(x) = x2 − 3. What is the value of f(g(−1))?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

First g(−1) = −12 − 3 = −2. Then f(−2) = −3(−2) + 5 = 11.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: What is the greater solution of the equation x2 − 11x + 28 = 0?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

The equation factors as (x − 4)(x − 7) = 0, so x = 4 or x = 7. The greater solution is 7.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to (2x + 1)(4x − 5)?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Multiply each term: 2x · 4x = 8x2, the middle terms give -10x + (4x) = −6x, and 1 · −5 = −5.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question: What is the solution to the equation 6x = 22x + 8?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 3

Cross-multiply: 6(x + 8) = 22x, so 48 = 16x and x = 3.

questions.question: Cylinder A has radius 2 and height 5. Cylinder B has radius 4 and height 5. The volume of cylinder B is how many times the volume of cylinder A?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 4

Volume = πr2h. Multiplying the radius by 2 multiplies the volume by 22 = 4.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question:
5x + 6y = 10
rx + 18y = 32

In the system of equations above, r is a constant. If the system has no solution, what is the value of r?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

A system of two linear equations has no solution when the lines are parallel: the coefficients of x and y are proportional but the constants are not. The y-coefficient is multiplied by 3, so r = 5 × 3 = 15 (and 10 × 3 = 30 ≠ 32).

questions.question: If 4x + 3 = 2x + 8, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Write both sides as powers of 2: 22(x + 3) = 2x + 8. So 2(x + 3) = x + 8, which gives x = 2.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question: The graphs of y = −x + 6 and y = 5x − 24 intersect at the point (a, b) in the xy-plane. What is the value of a + b?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: D

Set the expressions equal: −x + 6 = 5x − 24, so x = 5. Then y = 1, and a + b = 6.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question: A food bank received a total of 48 items: bags of rice costing $6 each and bags of beans costing $12 each. The total cost was $510. How many bags of beans were there?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Let s and l be the numbers of bags of rice and bags of beans. Then s + l = 48 and 6s + 12l = 510. Multiply the first equation by 6 and subtract: 6l = 222, so l = 37.

questions.question: In right triangle ABC, angle C is a right angle, BC = 7, AC = 24, and AB = 25. What is the value of cos B?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

cos B = BC/AB = 725 (SOH-CAH-TOA, measured from angle B).

questions.skill: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
questions.question: A paint mixture uses 4 liters of blue paint for every 3 liters of white paint. How many liters of blue paint are needed for 21 liters of white paint?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 28

The ratio is 4 : 3. 21 is 7 times 3, so the answer is 7 × 4 = 28 liters.

questions.question: Line p is defined by x + 6y = 11. Line q is perpendicular to line p in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line q?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 6

Write line p in slope-intercept form: y = −16x + 116, so its slope is −16. Perpendicular slopes are negative reciprocals: 6.

questions.skill: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables
questions.question:
y = x2 + 8
y = −2x + 11

The graphs of the equations in the system intersect at two points. What is the sum of the x-coordinates of the two points?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

Set the equations equal: x2 + 2x − 3 = 0. The sum of the solutions of x2 + bx + c = 0 is −b, which is −2.

questions.question: In isosceles triangle PQR, PQ = PR, and the measure of angle P is 24°. Side QR is extended past R to point S. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle PRS?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: B

The base angles are equal: (180 − 24) ÷ 2 = 78°. Angle PRS is supplementary to angle PRQ: 180 − 78 = 102°.

questions.skill: Linear inequalities in one or two variables
questions.question: What is the greatest integer value of x that satisfies the inequality 7x − 25 < 45?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: C

Add 25: 7x < 70. Divide by 7: x < 10. The greatest integer less than 10 is 9.

questions.skill: Inference from sample statistics and margin of error
questions.question: A random sample of the students at a large high school was surveyed, and 31% of those surveyed said they support a new park. The margin of error for the estimate is 4 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion?
options: It is plausible that between 27% and 35% of all students at a large high school support the new park.
Between 27% and 35% of the people in the sample support the new park.
Exactly 31% of all students at a large high school support the new park.
It is plausible that between 23% and 31% of all students at a large high school support the new park.
questions.correct: It is plausible that between 27% and 35% of all students at a large high school support the new park.
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

A margin of error gives a plausible range for the population value: the estimate plus or minus the margin.

questions.question: The expression (7x − 8)2 is equivalent to 49x2 + kx + 64, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

(a + b)2 = a2 + 2ab + b2, so k = 2(7)(−8) = −112.

questions.question: The value of a delivery truck was $33,000 when it was new and decreases by $1,900 each year. After how many years will the value of the delivery truck be $21,600?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 6

Solve 33000 − 1900t = 21600: 1900t = 11400, so t = 6.

questions.skill: Systems of two linear equations in two variables
questions.question:
2x + 3y = −3
x + 4y = −4

If (x, y) is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of x?
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: 0

Solve by elimination or substitution: the solution is x = 0, y = −1. So x = 0.

questions.skill: One-variable data: distributions and measures of center and spread
questions.question: A data set consists of the values 12, 13, 25, 27, 35, 39, 95. If the value 95 is removed from the data set, which of the following statements is true?
options: The mean decreases, and the median decreases.
The mean decreases, and the median stays the same.
The mean increases, and the median increases.
The mean stays the same, and the median decreases.
questions.correct: The mean decreases, and the median decreases.
questions.answer_key:
Correct Answer: A

Removing the much larger value 95 lowers the mean a lot. The median changes from 27 (the 4th of 7 values) to the average of 25 and 27, which is 26, so it also decreases.
